_note: Edit this when you buy, sell, or enter new stop orders. 'current_stop' is what you actually have live on Robinhood right now - set it to null if you have no stop on that coin, and the next run will tell you what to enter. 'spread_pct' is the 'Buy spread (x%)' figure from the coin's order ticket; it drifts slowly, so re-read it every few weeks. 'room_override_pct' forces a width instead of the measured one; leave null to let the script decide.
